label: Strong moral supervenience entails weak moral supervenience
meaning: At an arbitrary chosen admitted world, instantiate the strong cross-world condition with that world twice. This only proves logical strength over identical selected profile types.

strong_version_needed.fcbba05b-bd6a-4156-a730-73931df20bed: Strong supervenience is the explicit hypothesis whose weakening is being certified, not a claim that reality satisfies it.
